title: Meet 3dx Phone
summary: Your feed, messages and notifications in a small window that floats over 3DXChat. Check what's new without leaving the game.
points: Download it from the new 3dx Phone page — free with the account you already have, Windows only.
Three shapes with one click: phone, tablet, or the wide one with Top creators and who to follow.
Hide it as a small button next to the game's own buttons whenever you need the whole screen.
Unread messages and notifications stay visible, so you can stop alt-tabbing mid-scene.
It never touches 3DXChat: no patches, no mods, and no game file is read or changed.

title: Stories are here
summary: Share what you're up to right now — your story lives for 3 days, then it's gone. Tap your bubble at the top of the feed to start.
points: Pick up to 10 photos, add a short caption if you want, and post. No overthinking — it disappears in 72 hours.
See who has new stories at a glance: the colored ring means there's something you haven't seen yet.
Hold the screen to pause a slide, tap the sides to go back or forward. Works with arrow keys too.
See how many people viewed your story — each person counts once, no matter how many times they watch.
Promoting a calendar event? Share it as a story and anyone who sees it can tap straight to the event page.

title: Your calendar, your plans
summary: See what's happening and who's going. Create events, RSVP, and share them as stories so your people don't miss out.
points: Browse the calendar to see upcoming events — parties, meetups, streams, whatever the community is planning.
RSVP to let everyone know if you're going, maybe, or not. See the attendee list and who else is coming.
Every event gets its own page with a cover image, description, location, and all the details you need.
Share any event as a story — your followers see it for 3 days and can tap straight to the event page.
Tag your events so the right people find them — art, gaming, IRL meetups, you name it.

title: Spotify music on your profile
summary: Pin up to 5 songs so anyone visiting your profile can press play. Nothing about your Spotify account is involved.
points: Share your favorite music with 3DXFans: your profile becomes a playlist your visitors can play.
The only thing we store is the song id inside the link you paste. We pull no information from Spotify — no account access, no name, no email, no playlists, no listening history.
The player is Spotify's own official embed, loaded from open.spotify.com. When you press play, that traffic is between you and Spotify and follows Spotify's privacy policy.
Add a song from Spotify with Share → Copy Song Link, then paste it in Settings → Music. Playlist, album and artist links are not accepted.
Mark any song as featured to lead the rail on your profile; the rest follow in the order you set.
Rather not see players at all? Flip the switch just below - or the same one in Settings → Music - and no profile shows them to you, your own included.

title: Your own private radio
summary: Want a station only your people can touch? Ask an admin to set one up for you.
points: An admin can turn any station into a private radio, locked behind a secret code.
Only the people who get the code can add songs, pause or skip — everyone else just listens.
Perfect for events, crews, or whenever you want full control over the playlist.
Talk to an admin if you want your own private station.

title: Notifications & Discord alerts
summary: Never miss activity on your posts — now in real time and straight to Discord.
points: Likes, comments and mentions notify you instantly, with a live unread badge.
Connect your Discord in Settings → Notifications to receive alerts as a bot DM.
First join our Discord server, then link your account so the bot can message you.
Per-type toggles let you choose comments, likes, new followers or mentions.

title: @mentions in comments & replies
summary: Tagging people now works everywhere, not just in post captions.
points: Type @ in any comment or reply to autocomplete a user, with keyboard navigation.
Mentions render as clickable links that open the person's profile.
Tagged users get a notification — in-app, and via Discord if they connected it.

title: Premium access codes
summary: Share your exclusive content with a personal access code.
points: Generate your own 8-character code in Settings → Premium.
Fans redeem it on your profile to unlock your premium posts.
Access is permanent until you remove a subscriber from your list.
Rotate your code anytime to invalidate the previous one.
